mapper.select: SELECT epoch,enabled,publicationId FROM customer_service_knowledge_publication_state WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT publicationId,epoch,receiptJson FROM customer_service_knowledge_publication WHERE publicationId=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_service_knowledge_alias_outbox SET status='SUPERSEDED' WHERE publicationId<>#{id} AND status<>'SUPERSEDED'

UPDATE customer_service_knowledge_alias_outbox a JOIN customer_service_knowledge_publication_state s ON s.id=1 SET a.status='ACK' WHERE a.publicationId=#{id} AND a.epoch<=#{epoch} AND s.publicationId=#{id} AND s.epoch=#{epoch}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_service_knowledge_etl_outbox WHERE status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING')

SELECT publicationId,epoch,collectionName,DATE_FORMAT(createTime,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM customer_service_knowledge_publication WHERE epoch > #{afterEpoch} ORDER BY epoch LIMIT #{limit}
